title: trending-local-llms model contract
description: JSON Schema that data/models.json must conform to. Every model in the 'models' array is validated against this. Enforced by scripts/validate.py.

engines.description: Engine registry. Key = engine name; every engine referenced by a model must exist here.

backend.description: Backend(s) the engine runs on. One of CUDA (NVIDIA), ROCm (AMD GPUs: ROCm/HIP or Vulkan), Metal (Apple), CPU, or several joined with ' / ' in the canonical order CUDA, ROCm, CPU, Metal (update_trending.join_backends).

auto.description: True when the engine was auto-registered at ingest from a measurement's engine_repo (classified as an inference engine); the note cites the source post.

models.description: List of models. No duplicates (enforced by check_no_duplicates).

formats.description: Each format has its own name AND Hugging Face link.

hf.description: Hugging Face repo id for THIS format -> https://huggingface.co/<hf>
Primary Hugging Face repo id -> https://huggingface.co/<hf>

system_ram_min.description: OPTIONAL. System RAM / unified-memory requirement the post states (e.g. '16GB'). The CPU and Metal tables are RAM-bound (Apple Silicon is unified memory) and partial offload keeps the un-offloaded layers + KV cache in system RAM. Only ever a figure the source post gives; never derived from VRAM.

weight_gb.description: OPTIONAL. Weight footprint per format + quant the post states (e.g. '5.95GB Q4_K_M'). The budget a run needs before any context is allocated.

context_tokens.description: OPTIONAL. Context window the post states (e.g. '131072', '128K'). The KV cache scales with it and consumes RAM and VRAM alike.

storage_offload.description: OPTIONAL. Storage-offload requirement the post states (e.g. '640GB NVMe, experts on SSD'). MoE engines (Strata) run big models by streaming experts from storage.

engine_min_version.description: OPTIONAL. Engine minimum version / required flags the post states (e.g. 'llama.cpp b6xxx, --n-gpu-layers 99'); many figures only reproduce on a specific engine build.

backends.description: Backends the model runs on: CUDA (NVIDIA), Metal (Apple), CPU, ROCm (AMD GPUs). Always includes every backend its measurements render in.

supported_engines.description: Engines the model is supported by; each must have a measurement in 'engines'.

engines.description: Per-engine t/s measurements. One entry per (engine, date).

likes.description: Likes on the source X post backing this measurement (drives engagement-weighted t/s).

comments.description: Comments on the source X post backing this measurement.

reshares.description: Reshares/reposts of the source X post backing this measurement (strongest engagement signal).

views.description: Views of the source X post (reach; log-scaled in the engagement weight).

interactions.description: Total interactions on the source X post (likes+comments+reshares+views or the platform's reported total).

weight_gb.description: OPTIONAL. Weight footprint of the QUANT THIS MEASUREMENT RAN IN, as the post states it (e.g. '5.95GB PTQ1_0'). Per measurement, not per model: two quants of one model fit different cards. A figure only the post gives; never derived.

context_tokens.description: OPTIONAL. Context window this measurement ran with, as the post states it (e.g. '131072'). The KV cache scales with it and consumes VRAM/RAM alike.

system_ram_min.description: OPTIONAL. System RAM / unified memory this measurement needed, as the post states it (e.g. '16GB'). Partial offload keeps the un-offloaded layers + KV cache in system RAM; never derived from a VRAM figure.

storage_offload.description: OPTIONAL. Storage-offload this measurement needed, as the post states it (e.g. '640GB NVMe, experts on SSD').

engine_min_version.description: OPTIONAL. Engine minimum build / required flags THIS measurement needed, as the post states them (e.g. 'b6xxx, --n-gpu-layers 99'). A version is a property of the engine that ran the figure, so it belongs on the measurement, not only on the model row.

seen_posts.description: Post-granularity engagement: one entry per DISTINCT source X post (deduped by …/status/<id> URL; placeholder URLs are keyed by url+date+engine+tps). posts_7d / score_7d / last_7d_likes are computed from the entries dated within the last 7 days.

engine.description: Engine of the measurement this post reported (optional).

tps.description: t/s of the measurement this post reported (optional).

hardware.description: Hardware of the measurement this post reported (optional; part of a placeholder post's identity).

quant.description: Quant of the measurement this post reported (optional; part of a placeholder post's identity).

reshares.description: Total reshares/reposts across the model's source X posts (additive; optional).

interactions.description: Total interactions across the model's source X posts as reported by the platform (additive; optional).

posts_7d.description: Distinct source posts dated within the last 7 days (computed by sort_models).

buzz_7d.description: Breadth-first 7-day buzz: sum over posts_7d of 1 + 0.5*log2(1 + likes + 2*comments + 3*reshares) + 0.25*log10(1 + views) (computed by sort_models).

speed_bonus.description: log2(1 + t/s / 10) of the fastest in-scope (consumer, <=48 GB GPU incl. Radeon / Apple / AMD APU / CPU) measurement; 0 when no posts in 7 days (computed by sort_models).

trend_score.description: buzz_7d + speed_bonus — the within-band rank key (computed by sort_models).

engine_aliases.description: Optional {posted engine name: registry engine name}. Applied on ingest and every sort, e.g. Bonsai 2 27B maps 'llama.cpp' to 'llama.cpp (PrismML fork)' because its ternary GGUFs only run on that fork.

measurement_model_aliases.description: Optional list of STORE model ids whose names a measurement on this row may legitimately mention (a variant row naming its base model, a bake-off row naming the model it compares against). The documented exception to the measurement-attribution refusal (issue #652): it lives on the row as reviewable data, never as a code literal. Every counterpart must be a model id in the store (check_measurement_alias_map).
